FOR A COMPLETE

LIFE CYCLE SUPPORT

Project Delivery

TPS provides data center managers a single source of proven expertise for every phase of a data center infrastructure project.  From project planning and design through equipment procurement, installation and commissioning.

Preventive Maintenance

 A program of scheduled preventive maintenance and proactive replacement of key UPS components and batteries can greatly reduce the chances for failure during power outages, utility spikes, switching transients, incidents of line noise and other unexpected power related issues.

24hr Service

The unforeseen do not notify and your data center can not wait for later, for such reason, the 24hrs 7days service is designed to verify the situation of your UPS and thus avoid a downtime cost.  

OFFERED BY THE EXPERTS IN DATA CENTERS

Technical Power Services, Inc. was established in 1989, to provide customers with the best electrical and electronical service and maintenance in Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPS). Specialized in serving commercial, industrial and institutional customers’ electrical needs, by preparing hospitals’ MRI rooms, telecommunications business with environmental control units, UPS systems (on a 24-7 basis), power conditioning, surge suppressors, process chillers and the acquisition of gen-sets.  Whether you are in data center, communication, government or industrial industries, we offer the perfect pro-active service program for you.

SERVICE OFFERING

Preventive Maintenance

Implementing a comprehensive PM program where service is performed by our highly experienced technicians is the key for maximizing power system availability.

24hrs/7days Service

An expert technician will assist you all year round for any unforeseen in your Data Center’s UPS.

Battery Replacement

A single bad cell in a string of batteries could compromise your entire backup system. Proactively replacing them will minimize the risk of downtime.

Infrared Scans

Hot spots can represent the deterioration of electrical connections due to vibrations, improper torque, corrosion or other problems that can be early detected to prevent equipment damage.

Circuit Breaker Testing

Defective circuit breakers can allow extensive damage, cause personal injury and make an outage more widespread when a fault occurs. That’s why regular testing is crucial.

Data Center Assessment

Our efficiency assessments ensure that your cooling and electrical strategies evolve with your data center, maximizing performance, cost effectiveness and availability.
